businesses.business: insurance brokerage and risk management services

offering_description.value: Places property, casualty, employee benefits and other insurance for businesses, public entities and individuals as a broker and consultant. Also provides risk management, claims adjusting and third-party administration services, plus reinsurance brokerage and consulting.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; employee benefits consulting; reinsurance brokerage; claims management and third-party administration; risk management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, nonprofits, and employers seeking insurance and benefits programs, insurers seeking reinsurance; B2G: public entities, municipalities and schools; B2C: individuals and families buying personal insurance

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; employee benefits; reinsurance; public sector; construction; healthcare

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies placed; service fees: client-paid fees for consulting, claims administration and benefits advisory
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: brokers insurance between carriers and business, public and individual clients; service provider: claims adjusting, third-party administration and risk consulting for corporate clients

geography_served.value: global: US, UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, plus international network and correspondents in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: insurance brokerage, reinsurance, benefits consulting and claims administration

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: producers and brokers serving clients through local offices; agents / brokers: wholesale and reinsurance brokerage working with other brokers and carriers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance broker licensing by state and national insurance regulators, FCA in UK, fiduciary and benefits rules
